meta.title: Price-snapshot store — opening and closing numbers for every originated market
meta.source_label: nflverse schedules extract (games.csv) — community-maintained, not an NFL-published feed

policy.opening: The feed stores a single line per market per game and does not publish an opening line. Every opening cell is therefore null (unavailable). No value is inferred, guessed, or backfilled; opening lines remain blank until a source that publishes them is added.
policy.closing: The single stored line per market is treated as the closing line — the line the market settled against, and the same line used for closing-line accuracy in results/market.json.
policy.unplayed: Games that have not kicked off have no closing line yet; both cells are null.

summary.note: Opening-line count is 0 by policy: the feed does not publish opening lines.
